title: Hardship Band Months on a Changed Plan — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Desk Guidance
content:
A claimant shown by the latest waiver request to be in hardship earns band months when the installment of a current Benefit Overpayment Accounts plan is changed; the band months are added to the changed-plan months. The latest waiver request is the request lodged on the overpayment with the latest date received.

## The percent used

The household income percent of that request is its annual household income divided by the poverty guideline for its household size, times one hundred and rounded to two decimals. The poverty guideline is USD 15650.00 for one person plus USD 5500.00 for each additional household member, for every classification.

## Band months

| Household income percent of the latest waiver request | Band months added |
|---|---|
| At or below the classification's full-waiver percent | 12, the full-band extension |
| Above the full-waiver percent and at or below the partial-waiver percent | 6, the partial-band extension |
| Higher, or no waiver request on the overpayment | None |

| Classification | Full-waiver percent | Partial-waiver percent |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 200 | 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 200 | 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 200 | 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0 | 0 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 0 | 0 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 0 | 0 |

## Points the desk applies

- The band is read from the latest request whatever its decision.
- On a classification whose percents read 0, only a percent of 0.00, a request carrying an income of 0.00, is at or below the full-waiver percent.
- *Hypothetical:* a household of two (guideline USD 21,150.00) on a Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error account with an income of USD 40,000.00 has a percent of 189.13 and earns 12 months; with an income of USD 50,000.00, 236.41 and 6 months; with USD 55,000.00, 260.05 and none.
